insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Limited
plan_name: Model Policy for Persons with Disabilities and HIV/AIDS

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of sum insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment applies to every admissible claim under the policy

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; ambulance ₹2,000/hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: Except for accidents; waived if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions and HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, hysterectomy, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from discharge

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 500+ day-care procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusion clause 11

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured; assessed per IRDAI/Ministry of AYUSH benchmark rates

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of sum insured

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) listed under non-payable items in Annexure II

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly premium; 15 days for half-yearly/quarterly instalment modes at policy end; 30 days for instalment grace within policy period

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Anti-retroviral therapy cost, overseas treatment, organ donation, domiciliary, STDs, alternative therapies, stem cell storage, service charges

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons mentioned in the policy wording
